versions.changelog:
Initial release of cicd-playbook skill.

- Provides a structured template to generate comprehensive CI/CD playbooks for any service or team.
- Guides users to supply required details like service name, tech stack, CI/CD platforms, environments, deployment frequency, gates, and on-call setup.
- Outputs a detailed document covering pipeline stages, stage definitions, environment setup, branching strategy, rollback procedures, and on-call responsibilities.
- Designed to help teams document, operate, and improve their CI/CD pipelines safely and transparently.
